{{Quote|Yeah, and after they bloody their noses on your bunkers, my troops stand ready to punch them all the way back to their drop ships!|Trask|<ref name="Lead by Example">''[[Lead by Example]]''</ref>}}
[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] '''Trask''' of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Lannik (species)/Legends|Lannik]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], she and [[Ral Garas/Legends|Ral Garas]] were the advisors to King [[Amand/Legends|Amand]] and led a force of troops in support of the [[Uprising on Molos/Legends|uprising]] on [[Molos/Legends|Molos]].

==Behind the scenes==
Trask appears in the opening story in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Lead by Example]]''.
